purpose: The 4-row dry run of SAEA-E22-ESB-SHORTFORM-TAIL2S-TEST-V1, required before 2,735 contacts are spent on a population whose second read is the whole cost of this cell. Same protocol, same geometry, same media root, four rows. Three reads, in order of importance: 1. the built-in falsifier -- every request's prompt_tokens must equal 49 + analysis.e22_short_clip_encoding.llamacpp_audio_tokens(n_samples) for that row's variant media, which for these four rows is 88 / 556 / 270 / 166 and 1,080 in total, and a single disagreement means the audit's front-end model is wrong for this media and the cell STOPS; 2. does this variant's worst encode (38.360125 s, 507 audio tokens over five encoder windows, the largest single request the cell will send) complete live at -c 32768 -np 8 with no CUDA fault and no out-of-memory; 3. do both ESB scorers return per-sample rows on the sealed manifest through core.scoring_batch with verified = true. The smoke's own WER numbers are on four rows and enter no verdict. One cell, E22-ESB-2735-TS2-SMOKE-4. Preregistration: docs/readiness/2026-09-07-e22-esb-shortform-tail2s-test-v1-preregistration.md. NOT AUTHORIZED by this fragment: these four contacts are part of the SECOND read of the six calibration-exposed calls and need the owner's explicit GO recorded in this run's own exposure row.

E22-ESB-TEST2735-TS2-SMOKE-4.selection: the SAME four published segments the sealed 2026-09-05 test smoke selected -- shortest, longest, median and p90 by published duration over the 2,735 -- each exactly two seconds longer than its v1 twin. Named by this fragment and never by a command line, so a smoke can never quietly fly four different rows than the ones its exposure row names.
E22-ESB-TEST2735-TS2-SMOKE-4.estimand: none; this is the flight's own protocol on four rows

cells.serving_geometry: -c 32768 -np 8, 4096 tokens per slot -- identical to the flight
cells.factor: none; this is the cell's own protocol on four rows

shared_protocol.audio_path: raw audio, bf16 mmproj resident on the GPU, no feature cache directory
shared_protocol.obs: none -- an ESB utterance IS the request
shared_protocol.prompt_shape: the base TaskAdapter.assemble_prompt default: one system message carrying the instruction, one user message carrying the audio
shared_protocol.instruction: Transcribe the speech verbatim exactly as spoken. Never insert, repeat, or add any word you do not clearly hear in the audio. Output only the transcript text.

falsifier.on_disagreement: the cell STOPS and reports rather than being interpreted

metrics: peak VRAM and the absence of cuda error / out of memory / GGML_ASSERT lines
both ESB scorers returning verified per-sample rows through core.scoring_batch
evaluation.verdict_use: NONE. Four rows produce no WER claim of any kind.

execution_plan_basis.planned_model_calls: 4 rows x 1 contact plus headroom; the registered exposure ceiling is 50
execution_plan_basis.planned_speech_audio_seconds: 64.760188 s for one pass, rounded up to 100; the registered ceiling is 200
execution_plan_basis.planned_gpu_hours: 0.25 planned, 0.50 registered -- essentially all of it model load if a session has to be started for this geometry, and near zero if the cell attaches to a resident one

decision.go_no_go: GO only if all three reads are affirmative: the falsifier holds on 4 of 4 rows, the worst encode completes with no CUDA fault and no out-of-memory, and both ESB scorers return verified per-sample rows. Any one of them negative stops the flight.
decision.claim_surface: none; this smoke makes no research claim
